### Lip Balm giant pencil case / jumbo pen holder container

Turn one of the world's most iconic lip balm sticks into a fun and practical desk organizer!

Inspired by the classic labello design, this oversized container is perfect for storing pens, pencils, markers, brushes, rulers, and other everyday desk essentials while adding a playful and eye-catching touch to your workspace.

The removable cap reveals a spacious storage compartment that keeps your supplies organized and always within reach. Whether you place it in your office, studio, gaming setup, classroom, or home workspace, this giant lip balm container is guaranteed to become the center of attention.

Designed for easy 3D printing, the model prints in just two parts, with a snap closure.

 

XXL desk organizer perfect for:

* Pens and pencils
* Markers and highlighters
* Brushes and art supplies
* Small desk accessories
* Office and school supplies
* A unique gift for students, teachers, designers, artists, and stationery lovers
Bring a touch of nostalgia and oversized fun to your desk with this giant lip balm-inspired organizer!

 

Printing Tips

* Prints in 2 pieces for easy printing
* No supports required
* No AMS

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.16mm layer, 2 walls, 10% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.16 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 10%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF), PLA (#0078BF)
